nodes.description: Per-user total deposit principal stored in the TokenInfo struct; increased by deposit(), decreased by withdraw().
Per-user accrued deposit interest; updated by newDepositCheckpoint() and consumed first on withdraw().
Block number of the user's last deposit checkpoint, used as the interest accrual start point.
Per-user total borrow principal; increased by borrow() and decreased by repay().
Per-user accrued borrow interest; updated by newBorrowCheckpoint() and consumed first on repay().
Block number of the user's last borrow checkpoint, used as the interest accrual start point.
Constant rate scaling factor 10**18 used to normalise accrued interest rates.
Block time / block number supplied by the miner; drives the _block checkpoints used for interest accrual.
Checked unsigned addition, reverts on overflow.
Checked unsigned subtraction, reverts on underflow.
Checked subtraction with a caller-supplied revert message.
Checked unsigned multiplication, reverts on overflow.
Checked unsigned division, reverts on division by zero.
Checked division with a caller-supplied revert message.
Checked unsigned modulo, reverts on modulo by zero.
Checked modulo with a caller-supplied revert message.
View getter returning the user's deposit principal.
View getter returning the user's borrow principal.
Returns deposit principal plus freshly calculated deposit interest.
Returns borrow principal plus freshly calculated borrow interest.
View getter for the last deposit checkpoint block.
View getter for the last borrow checkpoint block.
View getter for the stored deposit interest.
View getter for the stored borrow interest.
Checkpoints borrow interest then adds the borrowed amount to borrowPrincipal.
Checkpoints deposit interest then reduces interest first and principal second.
Checkpoints deposit interest then adds the amount to depositPrincipal.
Checkpoints borrow interest then reduces interest first and principal second.
Settles deposit interest from accruedRate and stores the new checkpoint block.
Settles borrow interest from accruedRate and stores the new checkpoint block.
Computes newly accrued deposit interest: (principal+interest)*rate/BASE - principal, with no lower bound on accruedRate.
Computes newly accrued borrow interest, guarded by an accruedRate/BASE and zero-balance early return.

Unchecked-shape arithmetic in calculateDepositInterest: the subtraction of principal*BASE from the rate-scaled balance underflows whenever accruedRate < BASE, unlike calculateBorrowInterest which guards this case.
Amount the caller borrows, added to borrowPrincipal.
Accrued index rate used to settle borrow interest before the new borrow.
Checkpoint block supplied by the caller, stored into lastBorrowBlock.
Amount the caller withdraws, taken from interest first then principal.
Accrued index rate used to settle deposit interest before the withdrawal.
Checkpoint block supplied by the caller, stored into lastDepositBlock.
Amount the caller deposits, added to depositPrincipal.
Accrued index rate used to settle deposit interest before the deposit.
Checkpoint block supplied by the caller, stored into lastDepositBlock.
Amount the caller repays, taken from interest first then principal.
Accrued index rate used to settle borrow interest before the repayment.
Checkpoint block supplied by the caller, stored into lastBorrowBlock.
Accrued rate fed into the multiplication/subtraction that can underflow.
Accrued rate guarded by BASE >= accruedRate before the interest arithmetic runs.
Local copy of borrowPrincipal used for the zero-balance short circuit and interest math.
Local sum a + b validated by require(c >= a) before being returned.

edges.reason: Miner-influenced block time/height is passed as the _block checkpoint of borrow(), making interest settlement timestamp dependent.
Miner-influenced block time/height is passed as the _block checkpoint of withdraw(), making interest settlement timestamp dependent.
borrow.amount is the input consumed by the borrow() routine.
borrowed amount is added into depositPrincipal-adjacent borrow principal storage field (borrowPrincipal).
borrow.accruedRate is forwarded to newBorrowCheckpoint() to settle interest.
borrow.accruedRate eventually reaches calculateBorrowInterest().
the _block checkpoint is written into lastBorrowBlock.
withdraw.amount is the input consumed by the withdraw() routine.
withdraw.amount reduces depositInterest first.
withdraw.amount reduces depositPrincipal once interest is exhausted.
withdraw.accruedRate is forwarded to newDepositCheckpoint().
the _block checkpoint is written into lastDepositBlock during withdraw.
deposit.amount is the input consumed by the deposit() routine.
deposit.amount is added into depositPrincipal.
deposit.accruedRate is forwarded to newDepositCheckpoint() to settle interest.
the _block checkpoint is written into lastDepositBlock during deposit.
repay.amount is the input consumed by the repay() routine.
repay.amount reduces borrowInterest first.
repay.amount reduces borrowPrincipal once interest is exhausted.
repay.accruedRate is forwarded to newBorrowCheckpoint().
the _block checkpoint is written into lastBorrowBlock during repay.
calculateDepositInterest.accruedRate is the rate multiplied into the scaled balance.
calculateBorrowInterest.accruedRate drives the guarded interest computation.
depositPrincipal is read to compute the rate-scaled deposit balance.
depositInterest is read and folded into the rate-scaled deposit balance.
When accruedRate < BASE the subtraction of depositPrincipal.mul(BASE) exceeds the scaled balance and underflows; the parameter directly controls this unsafe arithmetic.
BASE scales both the numerator term and the subtracted principal term of the unchecked computation.
borrowPrincipal is copied into the local _balance.
the local _balance feeds the borrow interest computation and the zero-balance guard.
stored borrowInterest is included in the newly accrued borrow interest.
calculateBorrowInterest evaluates the BASE >= accruedRate early-return guard on its rate parameter.
local c is the checked sum returned by SafeMath.add.
borrow() calls newBorrowCheckpoint() before mutating principal.
withdraw() calls newDepositCheckpoint() before mutating balances.
deposit() calls newDepositCheckpoint() before mutating principal.
repay() calls newBorrowCheckpoint() before mutating balances.
newBorrowCheckpoint() delegates interest settlement to calculateBorrowInterest().
newDepositCheckpoint() delegates interest settlement to calculateDepositInterest().
the arithmetic expression inside calculateDepositInterest is the reachable unsafe operation and lacks the rate<=BASE guard present elsewhere.
calculateDepositInterest subtracts the principal term via SafeMath.sub; if the product is larger than the scaled balance the checked sub reverts.
calculateDepositInterest uses SafeMath.mul for the rate scaling.
calculateDepositInterest uses SafeMath.add to combine principal and interest.
calculateDepositInterest normalises the result with SafeMath.div by BASE.
calculateBorrowInterest uses SafeMath.sub on the guarded branch.
calculateBorrowInterest uses SafeMath.mul for rate scaling.
calculateBorrowInterest normalises the result with SafeMath.div by BASE.
getDepositBalance() calls calculateDepositInterest() to report the live balance.
getBorrowBalance() calls calculateBorrowInterest() to report the live debt.
borrow() adds the new principal with SafeMath.add.
withdraw() subtracts from interest/principal with SafeMath.sub.
deposit() adds the new principal with SafeMath.add.
repay() subtracts from interest/principal with SafeMath.sub.
getDepositPrincipal() returns depositPrincipal.
getBorrowPrincipal() returns borrowPrincipal.
getLastDepositBlock() returns lastDepositBlock.
getLastBorrowBlock() returns lastBorrowBlock.
getDepositInterest() returns depositInterest.
getBorrowInterest() returns borrowInterest.

normalization_plan.reason: borrow.amount is a per-call parameter whose only effect is the borrow() principal mutation.
borrow.accruedRate is only routed into the newBorrowCheckpoint settlement call.
withdraw.amount is a per-call parameter consumed solely by withdraw() balance reductions.
withdraw.accruedRate is only routed into the newDepositCheckpoint settlement call.
deposit.amount is a per-call parameter consumed solely by deposit() principal growth.
deposit.accruedRate is only routed into the newDepositCheckpoint settlement call.
repay.amount is a per-call parameter consumed solely by repay() balance reductions.
repay.accruedRate is only routed into the newBorrowCheckpoint settlement call.
calculateDepositInterest.accruedRate has no meaning outside the interest formula that this function implements.
calculateBorrowInterest.accruedRate exists only for the guarded interest formula of this function.
the _balance local is a temporary copy of borrowPrincipal used only inside calculateBorrowInterest.
local c is the arithmetic result of SafeMath.add and has no independent semantics.
